data.name: Cozy Radiation Cleaner
data.detailed_description:
Cozy Radiation Cleaner

Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a dark post-apocalyptic exploration and cleanup experience where players step into the role of a lone radiation cleaner sent into the remains of a fallen world. Armed with a radiation detector, protective equipment, and specialized cleanup tools, players must travel through contaminated zones, locate hazardous radioactive objects, and restore abandoned areas once considered impossible to survive in.

Built entirely in Unreal Engine 5, the game focuses on atmosphere, immersion, environmental storytelling, and satisfying cleanup gameplay. Every location tells the story of a civilization destroyed by catastrophic radiation events, where nature, decay, and danger have consumed the world left behind.

Players will explore multiple large-scale maps, each featuring unique environments, hazards, visual styles, and gameplay challenges. From destroyed cities and abandoned industrial facilities to underground laboratories, ruined suburbs, military zones, forests, and contaminated research stations, every map introduces new objectives and increasingly dangerous radiation levels.

Using a handheld radiation detector, players must scan their surroundings to locate hidden radioactive materials scattered throughout the environment. Some contaminated objects are easy to detect, while others are buried beneath debris, hidden inside buildings, or protected by unstable environments. Players must carefully search each area, manage exposure levels, and clean or extract dangerous materials before the contamination spreads further.

The gameplay combines:

  • Exploration

  • Radiation scanning

  • Environmental cleanup

  • Resource management

  • Hazard survival

  • Objective-based progression

  • Atmospheric world discovery

As players progress, they will unlock better cleanup equipment, advanced radiation scanners, improved protective suits, and upgraded tools that allow access to higher-risk areas with stronger contamination. Dangerous zones may contain collapsing structures, toxic air pockets, unstable reactors, electrical hazards, or heavily irradiated objects requiring specialized handling.

Each map is designed with replayability in mind, encouraging players to fully explore environments, discover hidden contaminated areas, and improve cleanup efficiency. Dynamic lighting, volumetric fog, detailed environments, and realistic post-processing effects powered by Unreal Engine 5 create a tense and immersive atmosphere throughout the experience.

The world of Radiation Cleaner is intentionally lonely and oppressive. Players are not heroes fighting monsters — they are survivors performing one of the most dangerous jobs left in humanity’s final days. Every cleaned area represents hope, recovery, and a small step toward rebuilding civilization.

Key Features:

  • Multiple large post-apocalyptic maps

  • Radiation detection and cleanup mechanics

  • Immersive atmospheric exploration

  • Unreal Engine 5 visuals and lighting

  • Dynamic environmental storytelling

  • Progressive equipment upgrades

  • Hazardous contaminated zones

  • Realistic radiation scanning gameplay

  • Dark cinematic presentation

  • Detailed ruined environments

  • Survival-focused gameplay systems

  • Hidden radioactive object searching

  • Satisfying cleanup progression loop

Radiation Cleaner aims to deliver a unique combination of exploration, tension, and environmental restoration within a haunting post-nuclear world where every signal from your detector could lead to danger — or salvation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4160 / AMD CPU with 4 physical cores @ 3Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 760 2GB / AMD Radeon R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon R9 390X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
